name: Kroger Michigan Fresh Distribution Center Romulus MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Public-road entrance off Wayne Rd is an open, wide commercial driveway. Max-zoom (z21) over the driveway throat shows open pavement with a single sign/light pole, no barrier arm, no fence-line gate. Street View from Wayne Rd shows a monument sign and open drive, no guard booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance or the inner turnaround. The small structures near the NE turnaround are a fuel/maintenance canopy and trailer staging, not a guard shack.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach: the entrance drive runs a substantial distance from Wayne Rd, past a monument sign and employee lot, into the truck turnaround before reaching dock circulation; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved turnaround / staging area inside the NE entrance holds staged trailers (visible at z19/z21) before they reach the dock banks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Full continuous dock banks on both the north and south long faces of the building (trailers backed in on both), indicating separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open entrance apron and turnaround with ample unused paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Press release (Penske/Kroger, 2019) states 105 loading docks on the 606,000 sqft build-to-suit freezer/cooler DC; corroborated by long dock banks visible on both faces -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long head-to-tail trailer rows along both the north and south sides plus staged trailers at the NE turnaround -> 50+.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial parcel off Wayne Rd in Romulus, surrounded by woods/wetland buffer and adjacent to DTW airport land; broader setting reads Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: In/out share the one NE driveway with a small central island; lane count estimated as 1 in / 1 out (low confidence).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 30.1 acres for the traced paved truck-yard perimeter; the full deeded parcel incl wooded buffer is ~47 acres per the 2019 press release.
